# Change-Order Proposal: CRM Connector

The signed scope covers the reporting dashboard. The client has requested an additional CRM connector, which is not included in the original fee.

| Item | Proposed change |
|---|---|
| Work | Add the requested CRM connector |
| Price | Fixed change fee of **$7,000**, based on 40 hours at $175/hour |
| Client dependency | Provide sandbox credentials |
| Schedule effect | Estimated additional two weeks after written approval and receipt of sandbox credentials; this is not an approved calendar date |

**Decision requested:** Please approve or decline the $7,000 change fee in writing. Connector work will not begin without the sponsor’s written approval.
